name: tau2-fixed-bank-repeats-01
selection: In the original 28-task cohort take the smallest numeric ID in each stratum, in the listed order. All are previously observed development cases. Select by first-pass outcome and benchmark operation, without filtering by saved text, prior second-pass success or reversals.
order: Within each task and wave, sort writer blocks then arms by SHA-256 of canonical JSON [study, task, wave, writer, 'block' or arm]. Each solver seed is crossed with both original writers and each control is run independently in every block.
scope: Same-task native episodes on five previously observed customer groups. Transfer and unseen-customer evaluation are separate. Only the simulator receives its original task instructions. Banks, including voluntary empty ones, come from the same first-pass public interaction for each task.
primary: Pair each form with the native no-memory control in its task, writer block and wave. Report gains, losses, both successful, both failed, unavailable and task-equal percentage-point differences. Controls are shared across forms. Separate first-pass recovery from losing a first-pass success.
secondary: Repeat the contrasts against matched empty preload. Compare the same frozen writer bank across two solver seeds; compare the two independently written banks within the same task, form and solver seed. Report control variability, title/body exposure, final DB vs required communication, matched outcome cases, worker and simulator usage. Historical writer cost is counted once and separated from new solver expense.
failure_policy: Each of ten disjoint task-wave ledgers has its own spend, call and time cap. A received, recorded unpriced listed HTTP error reserves its wire-specific maximum within that ledger and the episode remains ungraded. Other unpriced sends stop that ledger. Submitted episodes are never retried. Missing or unstarted episodes stay in the denominator.
